name: BEE Hotel Add to Cart
description: Helper to add Bee Hotel units to the Commerce cart programmatically; provides an /add/product/{productId} route.
project_description: BEE Hotel Add to Cart provides helpers for adding Bee Hotel units to the Drupal Commerce cart programmatically. It exposes a route /add/product/{productId} that ensures a cart exists for the product's store and redirects to the cart page, and an AddToCart service scaffold. It also hides the default 'added to cart' status message when items are added from Bee Hotel's own forms.
